name: Seina Kaimana
source:
“Whatever it takes, no matter how bleak, there’s a way forward. A way better than this.”

The protagonist of the story. Because of an age old pact between her ancestor, The Goddess, and prominent demons, women of her bloodline hold powerful magical properties. She can bolster the strength of demons, just like a goddess, and they are obedient to her every command. She’s a haughty and curious girl who forges on for any options to escape her fate, even if doing so would put her in danger.
